notes.title: 1.0 Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

Backrooms: Hide Together has officially left Early Access and is now available as a full release!
Based on the valuable feedback from our community, we’ve significantly expanded and improved the game to deliver a deeper, more immersive experience. This major update introduces the following highlights:
🆕 New Features & Content
Improved Camera System: Enhanced perspectives for a more atmospheric and immersive experience.

New Map: Explore brand new areas and face fresh challenges.

Drowning Mechanic: A new survival element that intensifies the tension.
👹 New Creatures
Additional enemy types to increase variety and unpredictability.

Each playthrough now offers a unique and terrifying encounter.
🔧 Improvements
Numerous bug fixes based on player feedback.

Enhanced atmosphere, audio, and overall gameplay balance for a more polished experience.
[hr][/hr]
We sincerely thank everyone who supported us throughout development.
Now it’s your turn to dive into the full version, explore the new content, and share your feedback with us.

👉 Will you survive the Backrooms, or become a permanent resident of the unknown?

Major Update Is Live – New Weapons, Maps, and More!

What's New:

 3 new types of weapons added – You no longer have to run, you can fight back!
 2 new maps to explore
 Save system implemented
 Score system added
 Global leaderboard – See the top 10 monster hunters!
 Character customization – Choose your character color
 New types of monsters introduced
 New obstacles placed in maps
 New damage system
 Enemy spawn system added
 Inventory system improved



Bug Fixes:

 In-game voice chat issues resolved
 Improved AI behavior
 Fixed collision problems in some maps
 Improved interaction system
 Death-related bugs fixed
 Fixed AI sound bugs
 Fixed issues with the end screen

notes.title: 📢 Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello explorers,  

We've taken your feedback into account and made our demo more immersive and exciting! Here are the key improvements in this update:  

- Enhanced Atmosphere: We have reworked the lighting and sound design to create a more intense and immersive experience.  
- New Enemy AI:Smarter and more terrifying entities have been added. Surviving just got even harder!  
- Improved Interactions: In-game interactions are now more realistic, pulling you deeper into the experience.  
- Bug Fixes & Lobby Overhaul: We've fixed many bugs and revamped the lobby system for a smoother gameplay experience.  

The demo is now smoother, scarier, and more immersive than ever!
Jump back in and face the new threats! **Play now and share your feedback with us!

Stay tuned for an even better Backrooms experience!
